manualReview.scope: Second text/design pass after content revision; same assistant, not an independent human review.

englishNaturalness.evidence: A new resident exchanges names and first-meeting politeness with Nora. The English has been reviewed as short beginner utterances, not as a claim of authentic unscripted dialogue.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked every turn translation and all option explanations against the intended English meaning, speaker, object and communicative act.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Too is explicitly taught as a target before being assessed.

distractorQuality.evidence: A04 distinguishes introducing, asking and greeting; A06 requires reciprocal politeness; A07 recombines the greeting with either taught name construction.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: A new resident exchanges names and first-meeting politeness with Nora.

difficultyFit.evidence: Too is explicitly taught as a target before being assessed.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Audio reconstruction is labelled supported practice; the final task removes the model. A04 distinguishes introducing, asking and greeting; A06 requires reciprocal politeness; A07 recombines the greeting with either taught name construction.

transferQuality.evidence: A04 distinguishes introducing, asking and greeting; A06 requires reciprocal politeness; A07 recombines the greeting with either taught name construction. Evidence is same-session bounded recall, not a proficiency certificate.

overallCoherence.evidence: A new resident exchanges names and first-meeting politeness with Nora. Teaching, selection feedback and the terminal task retain the Lesson outcome and played role.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static flow review: optional help, typed fallback and per-option explanations reduce dead ends. No real microphone, perception or learner test was performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio has not received a perceptual/prosody review.
Exact-match retrieval recognizes bounded patterns; valid alternative English can fall outside its answer list.
